summary:
The selected current-only programme migration completion stays in the existing packaged CLI, GitHub adapter and sole owning plan. Membership alone does not place the new programme parents in their selected views. Its exact reviewed scope may declare initial Track, Roadmap and optional accountable Status values, bound into the prepared digest and original intent. Only absent values may be initialized; equal populated values are no-ops and different human or automation values stop the original operation. Returned membership/item identities and genuine scalar value IDs with invariant UTC timestamps require independent complete readback before dependent effects. Existing pilot and unselected cards remain unchanged. GitHub offers no if-absent/CAS for these planning writes: the selected cooperative operator window is an explicit assumption, not an enforced capability. Observation, ownership, assignee and hierarchy changes remain excluded.

Fresh migration collection bundles bounded initial schema, membership, view and selected-issue pages, drains every continuation and independently rechecks principal/project identity. Complete first pages are reused only inside that observation and never across effects. Both pre-send and independent post-effect guards remain within the unchanged 500-request/270-second envelope. The prepared actual-caller control traverses twenty selected issues, twenty-two memberships, eight views and seventy-seven effects, then requires zero effects on unchanged reprepare. Source fixtures and arithmetic request fit do not prove live timing, filesystem durability or native effects.

Current v4 inspection reads only canonical plan sources declared by protected enrollment and within the bound repository scope. Immutable forty-hex refs remain exact; main resolves through native GitHub to an exact commit and immutable blob, retaining repository/path/commit/blob provenance. Stable plan identity is separate from each fresh revision observation. Additional PR-read repositories do not enroll their issues. Product/schema1 behavior stays separate.

Native PR gaps are purpose-typed at their read sites. ObserveExisting and Implement can retain eligibility despite review/check availability gaps only when exact current owner, association, repository, head and files plus all relevant action prerequisites, intake and resources are established. Gaps remain visible and aggregate inspection incomplete; no Verified or acceptance evidence is synthesized. Identity contradictions and unknown or unclassified gaps refuse, and review/qualification/activation and ordinary delivery checks remain conservative.

Foundation PR4653 and connected completion PR4657 are source-delivered. PR4657 exact reviewed/tested tree335571e234832325d85e88474585781156354b9a was delivered at b7f655a31a51a63af6ccb14a49b75f8b002abe08 after hosted compilation, focused943/94/51 suites, full2743 tests and coherent required qualification. This source milestone does not establish native migration or installed adoption. The current prepared coherent source is .104; the published inventory remains .102. The sole release plan owns candidate, suspension and publication gates; no intermediate .103 candidate is needed. Final native IDs and stable enrollment/binding, actual qualified successor package and approved private caller, installed positive inspection/refresh/selection, human UI grouping/sort/order and coordinated real use remain separate gates. No intermediate package candidate, native migration, publication, updater activation or current-status retirement is admitted by source preparation. Original uncertain release effects and reservations remain unchanged; missing historical release artifacts or a historical binding are not reconstructed.

Qualification must independently establish the actual caller credential’s private project and private Checks capabilities. An endpoint permission header is not proof that a token type supports that API; fine-grained PATs currently exclude Checks. Browser OAuth that reads checks can still lack project scope. Stored gh OAuth is not automatically a CLI credential: the CLI selects GITHUB_TOKEN before GH_TOKEN. The operator contract links the official limitation; no token or private principal identity belongs in public evidence.
